scope: Pure synthetic core control tests; no numerical core solves and no scientific validation.

checks.name: default false hint expands only as needed and always uses a fresh final audit
fresh final sigma mismatch cannot inherit provisional root success
nonfinite expanded sigma fails closed before any bracket or audit contribution
expanded geometry failure cannot enter the pressure bracket
final field failure remains rejected after successful expansion/root
nonmonotone positive endpoint probes never create an invented sign bracket
high-sigma target reports numerical domain exhaustion without inappropriate long extension
two expansions consume scalar budget and cannot masquerade as convergence
cancelled expansion retains prior completed state and incomplete identity
global deadline during final computation prevents late acceptance
single active solve guard and finally cleanup survive automatic strategy
failed expansion releases active guard for a later clean solve
